metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the complete Rust LAS 1.4 inspector/renderer in [output](/workspace/output).

Key files:

- [Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml)
- [main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs)
- [las.rs](/workspace/output/src/las.rs)
- [json.rs](/workspace/output/src/json.rs)
- [base64.rs](/workspace/output/src/base64.rs)

The project uses only the Rust standard library and has an empty dependency table. It supports all requested point formats, structured VLR/EVLR records, CRS validation, waveform data, Extra Bytes metadata, strict LAS validation, JSON responses, and required exit codes.

Verified with:

```bash
cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml
```

Round-trip tests covered legacy GeoTIFF data, WKT, point format 10, waveform EVLRs, classification lookup records, typed Extra Bytes, and opaque/superseded records.

editorial.last_message: Claims a complete standard-library Rust LAS inspector/renderer; release build and local render/inspect probes are corroborated. Grades 219/223: one shared metadata prerequisite wrongly rejects absent waveforms in four point formats. Cargo ran zero unit tests; external interoperability is unverified.
editorial.notes:
Completed voluntarily with a substantial general Rust implementation, including handwritten JSON/base64 codecs and binary LAS parsing/rendering. No evidence of canned outputs or hidden-test access. Local probes cover formats 0, 3, 6 and 10, structured VLR/EVLR families, CRS, waveform data, typed Extra Bytes and CLI errors. One format-6 render/inspect roundtrip is byte-compared; most other probes inspect output without exhaustive assertions. Final release build and waveform inspection smoke pass; the earlier probes were not all rerun after the final refinements. Cargo test ran zero unit tests; cargo fmt and Clippy were unavailable in the pinned image. A hand-copied base64 probe failed before a shell-extracted actual render response passed, without weakening source validation. Local self-consistency does not establish external interoperability. All four hidden failures are legal no-waveform files in formats 4, 5, 9 and 10: las.rs:856–857 unconditionally requires descriptor/storage metadata, even though descriptor index zero is parsed as no waveform. The supplied specification explicitly permits that absence, and the test accepts omitted or explicit zero waveform JSON, so no scoring repair is justified. These four distinct wire-format observations reflect one shared implementation defect, not four independent bugs. Root verified all 223 unique cases, current prompt/test hashes, pinned agent and grader images, normal completion, model/Max effort, and API-only/apps-disabled isolation. Preserved canonical/session evidence matches all accounting: 65 tool calls (64 canonical plus one proven rejected patch), 28,300 reasoning tokens, and a $4.592502 API-equivalent generation estimate. The new harness recorded the rejected patch correctly in the original result; no backfill or regrade is needed.

Run conditions: apps explicitly disabled in the recorded launch; no external tool invocation observed.
